name: File Conversion Agent
description: Converts reusable conversation file artifacts into requested target formats.

skills.name: PDF To Markdown
skills.description: Convert an existing PDF artifact into a Markdown artifact.
skills.usage_notes: Requires artifact_id of an existing PDF artifact in the current conversation. Use when the user explicitly asks to convert a PDF to Markdown or when a workflow needs Markdown extracted from a PDF artifact.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, source artifact metadata, and converted Markdown artifact metadata

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID of the PDF to convert.

name.description: Optional output filename. '.md' will be enforced.

description.description: Optional human-readable description for the generated Markdown artifact.
